; =============================================================================
;  Notebook Lock - a XOVI / qt-resource-rebuilder UI mod for reMarkable 2
; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
;  * Long-press a notebook in My Files -> "..." (More) -> "Lock".
;  * Locked notebooks show a blank cover with a padlock (grid, list, search,
;    and the Recent/Favorites drawer) and the caption "Locked".
;  * Opening a locked notebook asks for the password first.
;  * Select a locked notebook -> "..." -> "Unlock" (asks for the password too)
;    to remove the lock.
;
;  This is a UI lock only. Nothing is encrypted; the files on disk, the
;  desktop/mobile apps and the cloud still show everything.
;
;  Built against xochitl 3.28.0.172 (reMarkable 2). The file paths and object
;  ids come from that firmware and may move in other versions.
;
;  The locked list is stored in /home/root/.config/remarkable/notebook-lock.conf
;  (one comma-separated list of document UUIDs).
; =============================================================================


; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
;  1. Shared state: password, locked list, helper functions.
;     `Values` is a singleton imported by almost every library file as `common`.
; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
AFFECT /qml/common/Values.qml
    IMPORT QtCore 6.5 NlCore

    TRAVERSE Item
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            readonly property string nlPassword: "carmelite4"

            // Set by the unlock window each time it opens, so the password
            // dialog knows whether it is checking our password or a PDF one.
            property bool nlDialogMode: false

            NlCore.Settings {
                id: nlSettings
                location: "file:///home/root/.config/remarkable/notebook-lock.conf"
                category: "NotebookLock"
                property string lockedIds: ""
            }

            // UUID -> true, rebuilt whenever the stored list changes.
            readonly property var nlLockedKeys: {
                const map = {};
                const parts = nlSettings.lockedIds.split(",");
                for (let i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
                    if (parts[i].length > 0) {
                        map[parts[i]] = true;
                    }
                }
                return map;
            }

            // Library items use "entity ids" and the document opener uses plain
            // document ids. Both contain the document UUID, so that is the key.
            function nlKey(id) {
                if (id === undefined || id === null) {
                    return "";
                }
                const text = String(id);
                const uuid = new RegExp("[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}");
                const match = uuid.exec(text);
                return (match ? match[0] : text).toLowerCase();
            }

            function nlIsLocked(id) {
                const key = nlKey(id);
                return key.length > 0 && nlLockedKeys[key] === true;
            }

            function nlSetLocked(id, locked) {
                const key = nlKey(id);
                if (key.length === 0) {
                    return;
                }
                const map = Object.assign({}, nlLockedKeys);
                if (locked) {
                    map[key] = true;
                } else {
                    delete map[key];
                }
                nlSettings.lockedIds = Object.keys(map).join(",");
                nlSettings.sync();
            }

            function nlCheckPassword(text) {
                return text === nlPassword;
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT


; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
;  2. Block opening. Every route that opens a document (library, search,
;     Recent drawer, links, "open last document") goes through
;     MainView.openDocument_helper - the same place the stock firmware asks
;     for a PDF password.
; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
AFFECT /qml/device/view/main/MainView.qml
    TRAVERSE Background#root
        RENAME openDocument_helper TO nlOriginalOpenDocumentHelper
        INSERT {
            function openDocument_helper(entry, openCall) {
                // If the document view is still loading, the original helper
                // saves the request and calls openDocument_helper again later,
                // so we only ask once, when the document really opens.
                if (entry && documentView.status === Loader.Ready && Values.nlIsLocked(entry.id)) {
                    root.windowNavigator.open("document/window/unlock", {
                        documentToUnlock: Values.nlKey(entry.id),
                        notebookLock: true,
                        action: function(password) {
                            root.nlOriginalOpenDocumentHelper(entry, openCall);
                        }
                    });
                    return;
                }
                root.nlOriginalOpenDocumentHelper(entry, openCall);
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT


; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
;  3. Reuse the stock "Password protected PDF" screen (with its on-screen
;     keyboard) as the notebook password prompt.
; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/modules/document/qml/UnlockWindow.qml
    TRAVERSE BaseView#root
        REBUILD onOpened
            LOCATE AFTER { loader.acceptAction = action; }
            INSERT { Values.nlDialogMode = args.notebookLock === true; }
        END REBUILD
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/modules/document/qml/PasswordEntryDialog.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            readonly property bool notebookLock: Values.nlDialogMode
        }

        RENAME acceptInput TO nlNativeAcceptInput
        INSERT {
            function acceptInput(text) {
                if (!root.notebookLock) {
                    root.nlNativeAcceptInput(text);
                    return;
                }
                if (Values.nlCheckPassword(text)) {
                    root.invalidPassword = false;
                    if (root.acceptAction) {
                        root.acceptAction(text);
                    }
                    root.closeDialog();
                } else {
                    root.invalidPassword = true;
                }
            }
        }

        ; The PDF "loading succeeded" signal must not fire our callback a
        ; second time when the notebook finishes opening.
        TRAVERSE Connections
            LOCATE BEFORE ALL
            INSERT { enabled: !root.notebookLock }
        END TRAVERSE

        TRAVERSE Header#inputHeader
            REBUILD text
                LOCATE BEFORE ALL
                INSERT { root.notebookLock ? qsTr("Locked notebook") : }
            END REBUILD
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT


; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
;  4. Blank thumbnails in My Files (grid + list views, also used by search).
;     The stock items already blank the cover for password-protected PDFs, so
;     we widen that check to "PDF password OR locked by this mod".
; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
AFFECT /qml/device/view/syncserviceexplorer/ContentItemBase.qml
    TRAVERSE MouseArea#baseItem
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            readonly property bool nlLocked: { return baseItem.type !== Entity.Type.Folder && Values.nlIsLocked(baseItem.entityId); }
            readonly property bool nlHidden: baseItem.passwordProtected || baseItem.nlLocked
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/syncserviceexplorer/ContentGridItem.qml
    TRAVERSE ContentItemBase#gridItem
        TRAVERSE ?#_image
            REBUILD source
                LOCATE BEFORE ALL
                REPLACE { passwordProtected } WITH { gridItem.nlHidden }
            END REBUILD
        END TRAVERSE

        TRAVERSE ?#icon
            REBUILD source
                LOCATE BEFORE ALL
                REPLACE { gridItem.passwordProtected } WITH { gridItem.nlHidden }
            END REBUILD
        END TRAVERSE

        TRAVERSE ?#_infoText
            REBUILD visible
                LOCATE BEFORE ALL
                REPLACE { gridItem.passwordProtected } WITH { gridItem.nlHidden }
            END REBUILD
            REBUILD text
                LOCATE BEFORE ALL
                INSERT { gridItem.nlLocked ? qsTr("Locked") : }
            END REBUILD
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/syncserviceexplorer/ContentListItem.qml
    TRAVERSE ContentItemBase#listItem
        TRAVERSE ?#thumbnailImage
            REBUILD source
                LOCATE BEFORE ALL
                REPLACE { listItem.passwordProtected } WITH { listItem.nlHidden }
            END REBUILD
        END TRAVERSE

        TRAVERSE ?[.objectName="\"thumbnailIcon\""]
            REBUILD source
                LOCATE BEFORE ALL
                REPLACE { listItem.passwordProtected } WITH { listItem.nlHidden }
            END REBUILD
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT


; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
;  5. Blank thumbnails in the Recent / Favorites document drawer.
; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/ContentEntriesGridItem.qml
    TRAVERSE MouseArea#gridItem
        REPLACE lockedByPassword WITH {
            readonly property bool lockedByPassword: { return entry ? (entry.lockedByPassword || Values.nlIsLocked(entry.id)) : false; }
        }

        TRAVERSE ?#icon
            REBUILD source
                LOCATE BEFORE ALL
                REPLACE { entry.lockedByPassword } WITH { gridItem.lockedByPassword }
            END REBUILD
        END TRAVERSE

        TRAVERSE ?#_image
            REBUILD documentId
                LOCATE BEFORE ALL
                INSERT { gridItem.lockedByPassword ? "" : }
            END REBUILD
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT


; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
;  6. "Lock" / "Unlock" entry in the selection "..." (More) menu.
; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/MyFilesMoreFoldout.qml
    TRAVERSE FoldoutOverlay#root
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            property string nlLockLabel: qsTr("Lock")
            property bool nlLockVisible: false
            signal nlLockClicked
        }

        TRAVERSE ColumnLayout
            LOCATE BEFORE ALL
            INSERT {
                ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
                    id: nlLockFoldoutItem
                    objectName: "nlLockFoldoutItem"
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    visible: root.nlLockVisible
                    label: root.nlLockLabel
                    iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/padlock"
                    onClicked: root.nlLockClicked()
                }
            }
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/ActionHeader.qml
    TRAVERSE HeaderContainer#actionHeader
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            // Converts a selection EntityId to text the same way the library
            // items do (by assigning it to a string property).
            QtObject {
                id: nlIdConverter
                property string value: ""
            }

            function nlKeyFor(id) {
                try {
                    nlIdConverter.value = id;
                } catch (error) {
                    nlIdConverter.value = String(id);
                }
                return Values.nlKey(nlIdConverter.value);
            }

            function nlSelectedKeys() {
                const ids = actionHeader.selection.selectedIds;
                const keys = [];
                for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
                    const key = actionHeader.nlKeyFor(ids[i]);
                    if (key.length > 0) {
                        keys.push(key);
                    }
                }
                return keys;
            }

            function nlSelectionIsAllLocked() {
                const keys = actionHeader.nlSelectedKeys();
                if (keys.length === 0) {
                    return false;
                }
                for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
                    if (!Values.nlIsLocked(keys[i])) {
                        return false;
                    }
                }
                return true;
            }

            function nlToggleLockSelection() {
                const keys = actionHeader.nlSelectedKeys();
                if (keys.length === 0) {
                    actionHeader.cancel();
                    return;
                }

                if (actionHeader.nlSelectionIsAllLocked()) {
                    // Removing a lock needs the password as well.
                    actionHeader.windowNavigator.open("document/window/unlock", {
                        documentToUnlock: keys[0],
                        notebookLock: true,
                        action: function(password) {
                            for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
                                Values.nlSetLocked(keys[i], false);
                            }
                        }
                    });
                } else {
                    for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
                        Values.nlSetLocked(keys[i], true);
                    }
                    actionHeader.notificationQueue.enqueue({
                        "text": qsTr("Locked"),
                        "icon": "qrc:/ark/icons/padlock",
                        "timeout": 2000
                    });
                }
                actionHeader.cancel();
            }
        }

        TRAVERSE Component#moreFoldout > MyFilesMoreFoldout
            LOCATE AFTER ALL
            INSERT {
                nlLockVisible: !actionHeader.selection.hasFolder && !actionHeader.selection.hasPage
                onNlLockClicked: actionHeader.nlToggleLockSelection()
                Component.onCompleted: {
                    nlLockLabel = actionHeader.nlSelectionIsAllLocked() ? qsTr("Unlock") : qsTr("Lock");
                }
            }
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
